summary: 5 features and 4 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • frontend-config: add long-message collapse setting (cb82567)
  • localization: expose localized task and dungeon copy (dc00d4c)

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: localize dungeon metadata and cards (4cf500e)
  • settings: add long message collapse preference (49a17bc)
  • hero: refresh dungeon rail roster labels (0af995f)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • codebuddy: surface CLI failures and suppress replay duplicates (885f2bc)

HagiCode-org/web

  • proposal: disable explore mode by default (7c4cbe5)
  • statusbar: remove retired research achievements (1eed6cb)
  • conversation: deduplicate streaming fragments and errors (5eef955)
